result.title: Toward Knowledge-Centric AI: Discovering, Internalizing, and Using Explicit Knowledge Across Agents and Generations
result.summary: Knowledge is how understanding accumulates across people and generations: durable records that outlive their producers and that others can check, combine, teach, and correct. AI agents are now built and run by many independent users and organizations, and each agent is upgraded, replaced, or retired within months. Yet what an agent learns stays trapped in model parameters, a transient context window, or a system-specific memory store that is appended to and retrieved from rather than processed. We argue that the next generation of AI should be knowledge-centric, built around an explicit, continuously evolving knowledge layer independent of any single agent. In this loop, agents discover knowledge from their environments and trajectories; the layer internalizes it by turning fragmented, heterogeneous records and experience into composable, revisable understanding; and agents across systems and generations use the result and return new outcomes for revision. While discovery and use have advanced rapidly with large language model agents, internalization remains the bottleneck. We argue that internalization should become a persistent object of training and maintenance-centered on condition-preserving conceptualization of events and deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning across noisy, heterogeneous representations (text, tables, graphs, rules, and programs). To power this layer, we call for knowledge foundation models that provide shared neural capacity for knowledge computation, and outline a research agenda showing how an explicit knowledge layer delivers reuse, cost efficiency, auditability, and continuity across agent generations.

AI.brief_summary: 这是一篇立场论文：主张构建独立于单个智能体的显式知识层，由智能体从环境与轨迹中发现知识，知识层将其内化为可组合、可修订的理解，再供跨系统、跨代智能体使用，并呼吁发展共享的知识基础模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把「内化」作为持久的训练与维护对象，并强调状态的可审计、可复用与成本，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的训练监督、状态抽象及跨轨迹复用评价形成概念类比，但材料未涉及视觉推理或具体机制，可供核查。
